t: The Italia Conti Academy of Theatre Arts is a drama school founded in 1911 by the English actress Italia Conti. It offers courses in acting, musical theatre and dance, mostly for students aged sixteen and over, with younger learners catered for through its associate schools and pre-vocational courses. Italia Conti herself is the reason the school exists, and it still carries her name more than a century on. One thing to know: the school today is based in Woking, in Surrey, so this London spot is tied to its story rather than its main campus.
